MoveToGeofeatureTarget.description: Structural identity only. Task admission must resolve a live point Geofeature.

TargetAltitude.description: Optional target height in metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid. Omission imposes no vertical target.

MoveTo.description: S1 implemented input: queued coordinate-position Move To. Completion is reported by the Asset; Core does not infer arrival.

Pause.description: Representative tagged input binding only. Control ordering, validity and suspension remain operational work.

EnrollmentGrant.description: Deployment-signed first Enrollment grant; caller retains and presents its prepared credential secret. No secret is returned.

SourceInstant.description: Original source timestamp spelling is retained, including accepted fractional seconds and UTC offset spelling.

RepresentativeMoveTo.description: Retained S0 structural broader Command input; not advertised by the S1 operational Catalog.

CommitCursor.description: Opaque committed Core boundary within one Dataset.

Accept-Encoding.description: Declares request JSON receiver support: gzip, identity.

Content-Encoding.description: Omitted means identity; gzip selected only when complete eligible HTTP message is smaller.
